# Gentle King

> Gentle King (gentleking.org) is a free ministry site, confessionally Reformed and Presbyterian. It sets out the gospel of Jesus Christ, Scripture for grief and other hard hours, help for the fight against sin, Reformed doctrine held to the Westminster Confession of Faith, answers to objections against Christianity, and Sojourner, a free offline Bible study app for Windows.

The site is written by Colt, a layman in the Reformed Presbyterian tradition. He is not a pastor or an elder, and the site is no substitute for a local church. Scripture is quoted from the King James Version. The Westminster Standards are quoted from the text of 1647. The writing may be copied and shared freely under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 license. Please do not sell it, and please do not change the words and keep the name on it.

Anyone in danger or thinking of ending their life can call 911, or call or text 988, in the United States. Outside the United States, call the local emergency number. The comfort page gives these numbers and more.

## The gospel

- [The Gospel of Jesus Christ](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html): What is the gospel? Who God is, what sin has done, how Christ died and rose for sinners, and how you are forgiven and made right with God by faith alone.
- [Who God Is](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#god)
- [What Sin Is and What It Has Done](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#sin)
- [The Wrath of God and the Judgment to Come](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#wrath)
- [Jesus Christ, the Gentle King](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#christ)
- [Grace Alone](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#grace)
- [Repentance and Faith](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#repentance)
- [Justification by Faith Alone](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#justification)
- [The Life That Comes After](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#new-life)
- [Come to Him](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#come)

## Sojourner, a free Bible study app

Sojourner 0.3.3 is free Bible study software for Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit. It needs no account, works with the network off, and sends no telemetry. The installer is about 572 MB. It is made by the same writer and given away free.

- [Sojourner](https://gentleking.org/software.html): Free offline Bible study software for Windows. Thirteen translations, the Hebrew and Greek, Matthew Henry, Calvin, Spurgeon, and the Westminster Standards.
- [Scripture, and the Church Reading It With You](https://gentleking.org/software.html#sojourner)
- [Get Sojourner](https://gentleking.org/software.html#get-it)
- [Two Honest Warnings](https://gentleking.org/software.html#before-you-install)
- [The Library It Ships With](https://gentleking.org/software.html#library)
- [How Much Is in There](https://gentleking.org/software.html#reference)
- [Four Shelves, and Your Own](https://gentleking.org/software.html#shelves)
- [Panes That Follow Each Other](https://gentleking.org/software.html#panes)
- [The Original Words, for People Who Have None](https://gentleking.org/software.html#languages)
- [The People and the Ground They Walked](https://gentleking.org/software.html#maps)
- [One Search Box](https://gentleking.org/software.html#search)
- [Reading](https://gentleking.org/software.html#reading)
- [Notes That Stay Yours](https://gentleking.org/software.html#notes)
- [Preparing and Preaching](https://gentleking.org/software.html#sermons)
- [The Ordinary Days](https://gentleking.org/software.html#devotion)
- [Family Worship](https://gentleking.org/software.html#family)
- [What It Does Not Have](https://gentleking.org/software.html#limits)
- [Offline, and Yours](https://gentleking.org/software.html#offline)
- [Where the Texts Came From](https://gentleking.org/software.html#credits)
- [Feedback](https://gentleking.org/software.html#feedback)
- [Download Sojourner](https://github.com/z3r0Colt/sojourner/releases): The Windows installer and the four optional book shelves, on GitHub
